_comment: Common packages for the Honk test target. The pinned Honk wrapper and its verified release assets are installed by pin-honk-source.py.

packages.name: luci-app-lucky
packages.note: LuCI 界面跟随上游（已是 3.0.0）；lucky 核心从 3.x 起闭源，只在 https://release.66666.host/ 发布，GitHub 停在 v2.27.2。镜像用 overrides/luci-app-lucky/lucky/Makefile 固定核心包，构建前由 .github/scripts/pin-lucky-source.py 对齐官方最新发布与逐架构 sha256。
